placements.title: A capability only exists once it has been rehearsed
placements.frame: Does the practice or cadence described here reflect a capability that has actually been exercised, or an assumed one that has not yet been tested?
placements.why: src-2 states the constitutive principle as an aphorism — an unrehearsed rollback is definitionally not possessed — and src-1/src-3 (the monthly cadence decree, restated twice) plus src-4 (the named owner) are the concrete operational instantiation of that principle: the rehearsal cadence and ownership exist precisely to convert an assumed rollback capability into a proven one. This passes the narrative grain test — it names a subject (rehearsal-as-proof-of-capability) that future envelopes about drills, DR readiness, or other practiced-vs-assumed capabilities will keep feeding, rather than stating a one-time fact. No existing leaf covers this theme since the graph is empty, so it is minted fresh under the newly-placed Organization strata.
